problems.title: Four everyday problems, four plain answers

items.problem: Nobody can read the handwriting on a prescription.
items.solution: Send a photo. You get each medicine, dose, timing and number of days in simple words.

items.problem: A lab report shows H and L flags but no explanation, and that causes panic or neglect.
items.solution: Every result is compared with its reference range and explained calmly, with questions to ask your doctor.

items.problem: Branded medicines are costly, and few people know a cheaper medicine with the same salt exists.
items.solution: Where the salt, strength and form match exactly, you see a generic or Jan Aushadhi option and the approximate saving.

items.problem: Elderly patients forget doses, and medicines from different doctors can clash.
items.solution: Reminders on WhatsApp, an optional family alert, and a check of all active medicines against each other.

safety.title: Safety and privacy are built in

items.title: Not a doctor
items.text: It explains what is written. It never diagnoses, prescribes or tells you to stop a medicine.

items.title: Emergencies come first
items.text: Chest pain, breathlessness, self-harm and similar words skip everything and show 112 / 108 (and Tele-MANAS 14416).

items.title: Says when it is unsure
items.text: If a line is hard to read, it tells you and asks you to confirm with the pharmacist instead of guessing.

items.title: Consent and DELETE
items.text: Nothing is processed before you agree. Send DELETE and your data is erased.

items.title: Data stays in India
items.text: Stored in the AWS Mumbai region. Phone numbers are encrypted. Photos expire automatically.

engineers.intro: A production-style system: NestJS gateway and queues, a FastAPI + LangGraph AI service, Postgres, Redis, safety-first evals in CI.

items.a: No. It explains what is written on your documents. For any decision about your health, ask your doctor or pharmacist.

items.q: What if I have an emergency?
items.a: Call 112 or 108 or go to the nearest hospital. If you type words like chest pain, the bot answers only with these emergency numbers.

items.q: Can I trust the generic medicine suggestion?
items.a: It is a suggestion, not an instruction. We show one only when salt, strength and form match exactly. Always ask your doctor or pharmacist before switching.

items.q: What happens to my photos and messages?
items.a: They are used to answer you and to run your reminders. Photos are deleted after the retention period. Send DELETE to erase everything now.
This is a portfolio project in testing. There is no payment and no medicine ordering.
Hindi, English and Hinglish, as text or voice notes.

items.q: What if the photo is blurry?
items.a: It says which lines it could not read and asks you to confirm those with your pharmacist. It never fills the gap with a guess.

items.q: Can I try it without WhatsApp?
items.a: Yes. The live demo runs the same pipeline on sample documents. Please do not upload a real patient's report.
